uncited: *   **Bounding Volume (BV):** An axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) enclosing a set of primitives.
For a single primitive $b_j$, the elementary BV is the bounding box of that primitive.
**Sort Primitives:** Sort the primitives in the current set based on the centroid coordinates along the selected axis.
*   Initialize the left set bounding box $B_L$ to the elementary BV of $p_1$.
*   Compute the bounding box of the right set $B_R$ (primitives $p_{j+1} \dots p_n$).
The $O(n \log n)$ term comes from sorting the primitives at each node.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
*   **When to use:** When a good quality BVH is needed and $O(n \log^2 n)$ is acceptable.
*   **When not to use:** When exact optimal partitioning is required (infeasible) or when $O(n \log n)$ is strictly required (consider SAH or other methods).
